_doc: U-10 LAYER 4 — Lighthouse CI. Runs against the local dev server (default :8083) for home + pricing. Drive via `npm run test:lighthouse` (calls scripts/run-lighthouse-ci.js). Thresholds match the U-10 spec; tighten only after a baseline is established.

_thresholds_doc: SET FROM A MEASUREMENT, 2026-08-02, not from a guess. Performance was 0.30,
which no real page can fail, and this file's own note said to tighten it once a
baseline existed. No baseline existed because the job had been erroring on a
deleted URL for 20 consecutive runs and never scored anything (see OA-22).
First green run, desktop preset on the CI runner, 4 URLs:
Thresholds sit below the WORST observed score with headroom for runner
variance, so they catch a regression without going red on noise:
performance    worst 94 -> 0.85   (9 points; LH perf is the noisiest on
accessibility  worst 99 -> 0.95   (kept: axe already gates a11y properly on
38 routes x 3 engines, so this is a backstop)
If a raise is wanted later, raise it against a fresh baseline, not upward from
these numbers on the assumption they were conservative.
